kh: abbr. 柬埔寨；碳酸鹽硬度
khaddar: n a coarse homespun cotton cloth made in India
khaki:
a. 卡其色的, 土黃色的
n. 卡其色, 卡其色軍服

n. a sturdy twilled cloth of a yellowish brown color used especially for military uniforms
s. of a yellowish brown color

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>印地語 khaki「塵土色」，源自 khak「塵土」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>khaki pants；khaki uniforms；a pair of khakis</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">複數 khakis 常指卡其褲</dd></dl>
khakis: n. 卡其褲；卡其服裝；卡其黃（khaki的複數）
n. a military uniform made of khaki fabric
khamsin: n. an oppressively hot southerly wind from the Sahara that blows across Egypt in the spring
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">阿拉伯語（rīḥ al-）khamsīn（復活節與五旬節之間五十天的風）</dd></dl>
khan: n. 可汗, 商隊宿店
n. a title given to rulers or other important people in Asian countries
khat:
[化] 阿拉伯茶
[醫] 卡塔葉(阿拉伯茶樹葉)
n the leaves of the shrub Catha edulis which are chewed like tobacco or used to make tea; has the effect of a euphoric stimulant
khedive: n. one of the Turkish viceroys who ruled Egypt between 1867 and 1914
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">法語 khédive，源自土耳其語 hidiv，源自波斯語 khidīw（親王）</dd></dl>
khoum: n. 庫姆（茅利塔尼亞輔幣名）
n. 5 khoums equal 1 ouguiya in Mauritania
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">阿拉伯語 khums 的變體，字面意為五分之一</dd></dl>
